scope: Locked direct and transitive npm dependency packages; bot and dashboard merged by exact name and version.
method: Lockfile declarations are primary. Missing licence declarations and repository metadata are supplemented only by an installed package.json whose version exactly matches the lockfile. Notice text is taken from matching installed packages top-level licence/copying/notice/copyright files, normalized to LF and deduplicated by SHA-256. No package code is copied.
limitations: Package licence declarations are reported metadata, not an independent legal determination or an audit of all bundled components.
Platform-specific optional packages absent from the validation installation may have a lockfile declaration but no locally available notice text.
Built bundles, containers, binaries and modified dependency code require a separate distribution-specific obligations review.
Branding and AI-assisted artwork are outside this npm dependency inventory.
